items.observation: q7 solution maps the original circle centre (-3,1), translation vector (-2,1), origin reflection, and final centre (5,-2), retaining radius 3. The rendered SVG plots C0(-3,1), C1(-5,2), C2(5,-2) with equal radius and labels the final equation. q8 proceeds from the source graph signs to coefficients, then assesses slope and both intercept signs; its intermediate sign relations and quadrant conclusion are separated.
